title: Remulla calls for stronger Asean action vs cross-border crime

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said that criminal networks are exploiting advances in technology and growing cross-border connectivity, urging Asean member states to strengthen regional cooperation to counter complex threats no country can tackle alone. Remulla on Tuesday opened the 20th Asean Ministerial Meeting on Transnational Crime (AMMTC), where he is set to lead discussions on coordinated regional efforts to address major security threats. “Criminal networks are taking advantage of technology, economic integration, and cross-border connectivity. No single nation can answer that alone,” said Remulla. “Southeast Asia is growing and transforming. But alongside that progress comes security challenges that are more complex, more interconnected, and harder to contain within any one country’s borders,” added Remulla.
